fusions.name: Canopy Glide
fusions.desc: You glide onto an enemy up to 7 tiles away and bite. The bite deals 13 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 7 tiles, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Egg-Tooth Crack
fusions.desc: A sharp bite that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Flattened Ribs
fusions.desc: You flatten your body and glide 4 tiles forward, then move 25% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Stalker's Pace
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical hit chance rises by 25% for your next strike. Once every 6 seconds.
